info.name: BTP Automation - Azure Logic Apps
info.description:
Postman collection for BTP Automation Azure Standard Logic App workflows.

All workflows are triggered via HTTP POST to the Logic App trigger URL.
Update collection variables (logicAppBaseUrl, credentials) before testing.

Workflows covered:
- main-dispatcher (routes to child workflows)
- main-orchestrator (full E2E provision)
- subaccount-management
- entitlements-management
- provisioning-management
- authorization-management
- destinations-management

variable.description: Base URL of your deployed Logic App Standard instance
CIS Central OAuth2 token endpoint (used for accounts/entitlements/provisioning)
XSUAA OAuth2 token endpoint (used for authorization)
Destination service OAuth2 token endpoint (from BTP service binding credentials)
Destination service base URL (uri field from BTP service binding)

item.name: Main Dispatcher
item.description: Routes requests to child workflows based on the 'resource' field. Entry point for all operations via the dispatcher pattern.

item.name: Main Orchestrator
item.description: Full end-to-end BTP provisioning: create subaccount → assign entitlements → provision CF environment → create role collections. Call this directly without going through the dispatcher.

item.name: Subaccount Management
item.description: CRUD operations for BTP subaccounts and directories via the Accounts Service API.

item.name: Entitlements Management
item.description: Service plan entitlement operations for BTP subaccounts via the Entitlements Service API.

item.name: Provisioning Management
item.description: CF/Kyma environment lifecycle management. Create includes an Until polling loop (30s interval, 20 polls max, 15min timeout) waiting for state=OK.

item.name: Authorization Management
item.description: XSUAA role collections, roles, and user assignments via the XSUAA Authorization API.

item.name: List Users in Collection (via user subResource)
Destinations Management
item.description: BTP Destination service CRUD operations. Credentials come from a BTP Destination service binding (clientId, clientSecret, tokenUrl, baseUrl).
